verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents Jeeves Cash as multi-currency accounts with up to 5% yield and multi-currency balance storage, and the global accounts page pairs managing cash in multiple currencies with earning up to 5% annually. It does not say whether yield applies to every currency (USD, EUR, GBP, CAD) or only some, and the asterisk implies undisclosed conditions. Missing for 10: per-currency yield terms, eligibility/conditions behind the 'up to 5%*' claim, independent or hands-on corroboration.
